name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: 0.0.101's HDR/Dolby Vision and full-audio-track capture only ever reached brand-new items - an already-synced item that already had some media stream data saved (even the old, incomplete summary-only kind) never got re-checked, so real content already in the library kept showing SDR and one audio track. Confirmed live on a real 4K Dolby Vision remux. The existing-item backfill pass now also catches a stored video stream missing color/HDR data, or fewer audio tracks stored than the source actually has, and re-persists from the richer per-item detail fetch - not just missing bitrate as before. 269 tests, all green.
